label: MA5801-GP16 OLT
description: Huawei OptiXaccess MA5801-GP16, a 1U box-shaped OLT (442 x 220 x 43.6 mm) with the control and service functions integrated on one board: 16 GPON service ports and 4 GE/10GE upstream SFP+ ports, 140 Gbit/s switching capacity. There are no line-card slots - the box is the configuration, so unlike the MA5800 chassis this spec is the whole device, not one populated slot. The 4 'common interfaces' the datasheet lists (console, alarm and BITS-style dry contacts) are not IP interfaces and are not modelled. Requested in #198; port counts and capacity from Huawei's MA5801 specification table.
